proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
  classical
  intro N inst hN hEven
  let p := M7.Supports.polynomial (M8.P4Family.support N)
  let F := M7.RecipeSignature.signature (M8.P4Family.recipe N)
  have hp : p = M8.P4Family.polynomial := M8.P4Family.literal_polynomial N hN
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hp]
    exact M8.P4Family.nontrivial.2.1
  have hpdeg : p.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hp0]
    have hn : p.natDegree < N := by
      rw [hp, M8.P4Family.nontrivial.2.2]
      omega
    exact_mod_cast hn
  have hprops := M7.RecipeSignature.signature_properties N (M8.P4Family.recipe N)
  have hmonic : F.Monic := hprops.1
  have hmod : F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N := hprops.2
  have hdiv : F ∣ p := by
    change EuclideanDomain.gcd (EuclideanDomain.gcd p p) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) ∣ p
    exact dvd_trans (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _) (EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
  have hF : F ≠ 1 := by
    dsimp only [F]
    rw [M8.P4Gcd.signature_even N hN hEven]
    split_ifs
    · exact M8.P4Family.nontrivial.1
    · intro h
      have he := congrArg (Polynomial.eval 1) h
      norm_num at he
  have hd := M8.DiagonalPolynomial.distance_two N p F hp0 hpdeg hmonic hF hdiv hmod
  have hi := M8.DiagonalPolynomial.delta_not_image N p F hpdeg hmonic hF hdiv hmod
  have hn := M8.DiagonalPolynomial.coefficients_nonzero N p hp0 hpdeg
  have hc : M6.Coordinates.coefficients N p = M7.Supports.indicator (M8.P4Family.support N) := by
    apply M7.Domain.coefficients_indicator
  rw [hc] at hd hi hn
  have hw := M8.Diagonal.diagonal_witness N (M7.Supports.indicator (M8.P4Family.support N))
  have hl := M8.Diagonal.logical_lower_bound N (M7.Supports.indicator (M8.P4Family.support N))
  unfold M8.Coverage.PhysicalTwo M8.Coverage.deltaPair
  dsimp only [M8.P4Family.recipe]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [M7.Transport.distance, M8.Diagonal.distance, ← hc] using hd
  · aesop
  · aesop
  · aesop
